resources.string: The TV took too long to answer. Try again.
Lounge couldn\'t reach USB debugging. Check that it is still on in Developer options, then try again.
The connection to USB debugging dropped. Try again.
This TV asks for wireless debugging\'s pairing code, which Power Setup can\'t use. Turn on USB debugging in Developer options instead, then try again.
Something other than this TV\'s debugging service answered, so Lounge didn\'t connect. Restart the TV, then try again.
This TV no longer allows Lounge. In Settings, open Power Setup and choose Connect.
Shizuku hasn\'t allowed Lounge. Open Shizuku, allow Lounge, then try again.
Shizuku couldn\'t run that. Open Shizuku and check that it is running.
